rationale.edition: The changed-file list spans both repositories: 29 OSS paths under scripts/translations, src/api, src/core, src/infra, src/jobs, and web/src (alert-calibration web components plus locale strings), and 7 enterprise paths under o2_enterprise/src/enterprise/alert_calibration_collect and o2_enterprise/src/enterprise/alert_calibration_service. The diff is a linked OSS+ENT sister pair (#2988) carrying the enterprise collector/service alongside the OSS UI and wiring, so edition is 'both'.
rationale.skip: No skip applies. The trigger comment and feature hint are empty, so there is no explicit opt-out label/comment, and the change is user-facing: it flips alert calibration to enabled-by-default and alters the digest view's coverage notes.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. AlertCalibrationSettings.schema.ts flips the CONFIG_DEFAULTS 'enabled' value from false to true, so the settings form now presents the feature ON by default, and digests.ts removes the 'coverage_meta_fallback_used' column and its 'metaFallbackUsed' coverage note from the digest rendering. These are user-visible default-state and rendering changes to the Alert Calibration UI, not just backend plumbing.
rationale.area: Alert Calibration is an alert-coverage feature whose components live under web/src/components/alert_calibration, and it calibrates whether alerts fire, so the closest existing Playwright area is Alerts.
rationale.group: The ci_matrix.json and tests/ui-testing tree live in the openobserve repo, which is not checked out here, so I could not read the exact shard groups; I assign the closest sensible group 'Alerts-Calibration' and flag that the Engineer must confirm or create it in tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix/ci_matrix.json.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The only spec files changed are Vitest unit tests under web/src/components/alert_calibration/*.spec.ts and Rust #[cfg(test)] modules inside o2_enterprise, which are unit coverage, not Playwright E2E coverage; no tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/**/*.spec.js paths are touched.
